description: CoinGecko spot prices for up to 10 coins (by CoinGecko id, e.g. bitcoin,ethereum) in one currency, with 24h change. Prices are CoinGecko's aggregated spot prices; no history. Choose this tool for: CoinGecko spot prices for up to 10 coins in one currency. Close alternatives on this server: finance_binance_prices (Binance spot last price for one trading pair); crypto_tao_alpha_prices (Alpha token spot price in TAO, pool liquidity, and reserve). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

ids.description: Comma-separated CoinGecko ids, up to 10 (e.g. bitcoin,ethereum)

vs.description: Quote currency code, e.g. usd, eur (default usd)
